## Page 1

October 31, 2026 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Subject: Intimation regarding Scheme of Amalgamation of Three Wholly Owned Subsidiaries with 
Aurionpro Solutions Limited 
 
We wish to inform you that the Board of Directors of Aurionpro Solutions Limited (“Company”), at its 
meeting held on 31st October, 2026, has considered and approved the Scheme of Amalgamation of its three 
wholly owned subsidiaries, namely, Aurofidel Outsourcing Limited, Intellvisions Solutions Private 
Limited and Skanan Hardware Private Limited (“Transferor Companies”), with and into Aurionpro 
Solutions Limited, pursuant to Sections 230 to 232 and other applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 
2013, read with the rules made thereunder. 
The Scheme is subject to requisite statutory and regulatory approvals, including the approval of the 
National Company Law Tribunal (NCLT), shareholders and creditors, wherever applicable, and other 
relevant authorities. 
The detailed disclosures pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure 
Requirements) Regulations, 2015, read with SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-
CFDPOD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed herewith as Annexure I. 
The above disclosures are available on the website of the Company at www.aurionpro.com  
 
This is for your information and records. 
 
Yours Sincerely, 
 
 
For Aurionpro Solutions Limited, 
 
 
 
Ninad Kelkar 
Company Secretary

Whether the transaction would fall 
within related party transactions? If yes, 
whether the same is done at “arm’s 
length”; 
The transaction involves the amalgamation of wholly owned 
subsidiaries with their holding company and RPT to that extent. 
However, except common directorship none of the Directors/ 
promoters have any personal interest in those subsidiaries. 
 
The Ministry of Corporate Affairs has clarified vide its General 
Circular No. 30/2014 dated July 17, 2014 that transactions arising 
out of compromise, arrangements and amalgamations dealt under 
specific provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, will not fall within 
the purview of related party transaction in terms of Section 188 of 
the Companies Act, 2013 
Further, pursuant to Regulation 23 of the Securities and Exchange 
Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, as amended (‘Listing Regulations’), the 
provisions of related party transactions are not applicable to 
transactions between the holding company and its wholly owned 
subsidiary. 
Area of business of the entity(ies); 
Aurofidel Outsourcing Limited (AOL) 
AOL engaged in the business of carrying out functional and 
technical Business Processing Outsourcing Services, Knowledge 
Processing Outsourcing services. 
Intellvisions Solutions Private Limited (ISPL) 
ISPL engaged in the business of providing IT training, 
consultancy, software and hardware development, system 
integration, data processing, research, staffing and recruitment

Rationale for amalgamation/ merger; 
The proposed amalgamation is part of an initiative to rationalize 
the group structure and merge or close down the subsidiaries with 
minimal operations. The initiative is expected to bring and 
efficient structure and save operational and compliance cost. 
In case of cash consideration – amount or 
otherwise share exchange ratio; 
Since the Transferor Companies are wholly owned subsidiaries of 
the Transferee Company, no consideration shall be paid in cash or 
otherwise, and no new equity shares shall be issued by the 
Transferee Company pursuant to the Scheme. 
Brief details of change in shareholding 
pattern (if any) of listed entity. 
There will be no change in the shareholding pattern of the 
Company pursuant to the Scheme, as no new equity shares are 
proposed to be issued.
